## What this changes, and why

## How it is tested

- [ ] A program test (or a unit test for host code) that fails before this change and passes after it
- [ ] `bin/zr-dev test --changed` passes; `bin/minitest` for a change to the compiler or the runtime
- [ ] `bundle exec rake lint` and `bin/steep check` pass
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ryanseys/zr/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
